title: kalimeris biennis
intro: Kalimeris biennis, commonly known as the Dyer's Woad or Chinese Aster, is a flowering plant species in the family Asteraceae. It is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may help reduce pain and improve overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Kalimeris biennis include its ability to inhibit the growth of certain bacteria and viruses, making it a potential natural remedy for infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
